name: White-throated Kingfisher
line: Perches over the mangrove channels and drops on fish. You hear the rattle before you see the blue.

name: Little Egret
line: Stalks the mudflats at low tide, stirring up prey with its yellow feet.

name: Brahminy Kite
line: Chestnut and white, circling the Mandovi for scraps from the fishing boats.

name: Ground Skimmer
line: Hunts low over the khazan fields. Its young grow up in the paddy water.

name: Tiger Prawn
line: The khazan sluice lets young prawns in on the tide: a harvest as old as the bunds.

name: Mudskipper
line: A fish that walks. It lives on the mud and breathes through its skin.

name: Garden Lizard
line: Basks on the dune grass and flushes red at the throat when showing off.

name: Ghost Crab
line: Sprints sideways between burrows on the upper beach and is gone in a blink.

name: Grey Mullet
line: Schools in the river and leaps clear of the water for no obvious reason.

name: Little Cormorant
line: Dives for fish, then holds its wings out on the rocks to dry.
